'''Paklan''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]],<ref name="DMDS1" /> located in the [[Paklan system/Legends|Paklan system]] in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] took refuge on the planet after having a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posted on their heads by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Ja'Boag]], the leader of the [[Rim Commercial Mining]] corporation. After [[Zika]] led a band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to the two's location in a local diner, Savage and Maul [[Skirmish on Paklan|brutally]] [[Death|killed]] their assailants before fleeing the planet.<ref name="DMDS1" />
